content:
elis: Heads-up: I'm opening a small docs PR to reconcile a few mismatches in the Private/VPC offline guide after a customer support case. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/942
tommy: What mismatches?
elis: Three things surfaced: (1) installer path examples use `/opt/redwood` vs `/usr/local/redwood` in different places, (2) PKCS#11 snippet assumes `libpkcs11.so` name, vendors vary, and (3) the KMS example mixes token vs mTLS auth in the same snippet which confuses readers.
ops-ravi: For (1) we should show both canonical install prefixes and a note: "package maintainers may pick /usr or /opt; use `which redwood-agent` to find the runtime binary". Also call out permissions: `sudo tar --no-same-owner -xzf` for consumers who untar as root.
docsam: For PKCS#11 let's replace the vendor example with a generic table and two examples: `libvendor_pkcs11.so` and `libpkcs11.so` plus a short cmd to validate module: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/libpkcs11.so -L`.
tommy: Good. For KMS auth I propose two minimal snippets: token auth (env var KMS_ENDPOINT + KMS_TOKEN) and mTLS (KMS_ENDPOINT + CLIENT_CERT + CLIENT_KEY). Keep them as separate blocks, not mixed.
elis: I'll update the Python and Go SDK snippets accordingly. Also adding a migration note for old bundles: earlier bundles dropped keys under `/opt/redwood/keys/` but newer installer expects `keys/` next to config. Small shell command to migrate is helpful.
ops-ravi: SELinux note: many support cases are AVC denies for the extracted files. Add `semanage fcontext -a -t container_file_t '/usr/local/redwood(/.*)?'` and `restorecon -Rv /usr/local/redwood`. Add short fallback to set `setenforce 0` during install but warn to re-enable.
docsam: I also fixed a broken anchor to the HSM appendix (`/security/hsm-guide.md#pkcs11-module`) and replaced a stale link to offline manifest with an inline manifest example so readers don't need external URL.
ci-bot: PR #942: lint OK, linkcheck flagged 1 changed anchor (now fixed). See CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/14567
elis: Thanks — requesting review from @tommy and @ops-ravi after CI.
tommy: Reviewed, left tiny nit on wording for migration snippet; otherwise LGTM.
ops-ravi: Approved. I also updated the runbook with the clarified systemd service name mention (redwood-agent.service vs redwood.service) and added a checklist item for verifying PKCS11 module path during onboarding.
ci-bot: PR #942 merged by elis (commit b2d4f9a). Release note: docs v1.26.0 - "private/vpc: harmonize install paths, separate KMS auth examples, and generic PKCS#11 guidance" :sparkles:
elis: Pushed a brief follow-up to internal ops notes: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/private-offline (ops please verify during next release cut).
